channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: DeSantis vetoes sovereign immunity bill that would have raised liability caps for government negligence
item.description: Governor Ron DeSantis vetoed legislation that would have increased damage caps in lawsuits against government entities for the first time in 16 years. item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4% this year
item.description: According to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey, a holiday meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago.

item.title: Record Fourth of July travel brings heavy traffic to South Florida roads
item.description: AAA estimates 72.2 million Americans traveled at least 50 miles from home between Saturday, June 27 and Sunday, July 5, marking an all-time high for the holiday. Of that number, 61.4 million made the trip by car.

item.title: Palm Beach County schools earn third consecutive 'A' rating from state
item.description: The School District of Palm Beach County earned an "A" rating from the Florida Department of Education for the third consecutive year, reflecting strong student performance across all grade levels. The district achieved a record-setting 93.5% graduation rate. This year, 143 district-operated schools

item.title: Palm Beach County Fire Rescue responds to 29 fires during Fourth of July overnight
item.description: Fire crews battled 29 fires across Palm Beach County during the overnight hours of the Fourth of July holiday.

item.title: Driver killed in head-on crash on State Road 710 in Martin County
item.description:
A 40-year-old man was killed early Sunday after a head-on crash on State Road 710 in Martin County, according to the Florida Highway Patrol. The crash happened around 2 a.m. near State Road 710, also known as Beeline Highway, and Southwest Silver Fox Lane.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach was named one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League and was the only Florida city selected this year.

item.title: Port St. Lucie advances Florida Turnpike interchange at Midway Road as widening project continues
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation for a partial interchange at Florida's Turnpike. The move aims to accommodate growth in the city over the next 20 to 50 years.

item.title: Fort Pierce's Peacock House Art Foundation offers tours, classes and artist residencies at historic Crain Estate
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is transforming Fort Pierce into an artistic destination at the historic Crain Estate. The non-profit preserves the legacy of Jaxson and Mary Crain while hosting international artists and offering classes for all skill levels.

item.title: Breast cancer patient speaks out after Anthem Blue Cross denies reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, had her breast reconstruction surgery denied by Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield less than 24 hours before it was scheduled. The insurer said the surgical mesh called GalaFlex is still considered investigational.

item.title: St. Lucie County Marine Unit rescues two boaters after vessel sinks in Intracoastal Waterway
item.description: Two boaters were rescued Wednesday after their small motorized boat took on water and became submerged in the Intracoastal Waterway. Both occupants were wearing life jackets that kept them afloat until help arrived.

item.title: Hobe Sound community raises funds for man who lost fiancee Misty Dawn White in deadly home fire
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside the couple's home in Hobe Sound. Friends have launched a fundraiser to help her fiance Mark rebuild after the flames destroyed their belongings.

item.title: Stuart's downtown dock closes Monday for $3 million renovation, doubling slip capacity by July 2027
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a year-long renovation project funded by a state grant and transportation impact fees. item.title: FIFA clears U.S. striker Folarin Balogun to play Belgium in World Cup Round of 16
item.description: The FIFA Disciplinary Committee confirmed that United States striker Folarin Balogun will be eligible to play against Belgium on Monday in Seattle after his one-match suspension was suspended.

item.title: Argentina survives Cape Verde scare 3-2 to advance to World Cup Round of 16
item.description: Lionel Messi and Argentina beat Cape Verde 3-2 on Friday to advance to the World Cup Round of 16 after the island nation challenged the defending champion until the final minutes of extra time.

item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with Venus due to knee injury
item.description: Serena Williams withdrew from her doubles match with sister Venus at Wimbledon on Saturday due to a right knee injury sustained during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.title: Saint Andrew's Scots football targets state title after 10-2 season and district championship
item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots football team is working toward a state title run as they prepare for the 2026 fall season.

item.title: St. Lucie Mets Snap Nine-Game Skid With Late Comeback Win Over Tarpons
item.description:
The St. Lucie Mets ended their nine-game losing streak Sunday afternoon with a late offensive surge, rallying past the Tampa Tarpons for a 10-5 win at Clover Park.

item.title: Loggerhead Marinelife Center in Juno Beach offers sea turtle nesting season programs through September
item.description: Loggerhead Marinelife Center in Juno Beach is offering a variety of educational programs during peak sea turtle nesting season this summer through September. Guests can participate in guided Turtle Walks, the Hatchling Discovery Program, Hatchling Releases, Tidal Tots and Plastic Free July Community

item.title: North Palm Beach celebrates Fourth of July with fireworks at country club
item.description: North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse hosted a full day of family activities, live entertainment and fireworks on July 4.

item.title: DeSantis allies accuse Lieutenant Governor Jay Collins' wife of running anonymous social media accounts
item.description: Multiple anonymous social media accounts were deactivated after Governor Ron DeSantis' former communications staff publicly alleged the accounts were tied to Layla Collins, wife of Lieutenant Governor Jay Collins.

item.title: Florida communities receive $7.2 million in FEMA grants for Hurricane Ian recovery projects
item.description: Four Florida municipalities received new federal funding for infrastructure projects tied to Hurricane Ian recovery, four years after the Category 4 storm struck the state in September 2022.

item.title: Secretary of State Cord Byrd asks court to keep Paula Stark off House District 47 ballot
item.description: Secretary of State Cord Byrd filed court papers disputing St. Cloud Republican Paula Stark's account of a paperwork mix-up, with five state employees providing sworn declarations contradicting her claims.

item.title: Supreme Court allows states to count absentee ballots received after Election Day
item.description: The Supreme Court ruled 5-4 that states may count absentee ballots postmarked by Election Day but received afterward, preserving grace period laws that election officials in several states depend on to process ballots.

item.title: United States men's soccer team faces Belgium in World Cup knockout round Monday
item.description: The United States men's national team takes the field Monday night against Belgium in the Round of 16 at Lumen Field in Seattle after earning the program's first knockout stage victory since 2002.
